backend/main.mo: Main canister defining student, attendance, and user profile types with authorization checks and functions for managing profiles, students, and roll call data.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module passing old actor state through unchanged to the new actor structure.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Aggregated summaries of numerous frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI, state, utilities, and feature-specific logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying global background/foreground rules.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with all app routes and wraps them in AttendanceSessionProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AddStudentDialog: Dialog component allowing authenticated, authorized users to add a student with validation and backend submission.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper showing login status, rendering routed content, and launching profile setup when required.
frontend/src/components/EditStudentDialo: Dialog component for editing a student's details with validation, auth checks, and mutation to update student data.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling login states and clearing cached data on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save their name to set up their profile.
frontend/src/components/StudentAttendanc: UI row for marking a student's attendance and optionally triggering a WhatsApp action.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppPreviewD: Dialog showing a preview of a WhatsApp message before sending, supporting single and bulk mode.
frontend/src/constants/school.ts: Defines class and section lists and a helper to format class display names.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Auth hook providing authenticated/authorized state and user role queries using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and login status via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyExport.ts: Hook placeholder for monthly attendance export and a function that builds and downloads a monthly CSV using provided students and roll call data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRollCall.ts: React-query hooks to fetch and save daily and monthly roll call data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudents.ts: React-query hooks to fetch, add, update, and delete student records through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Hooks to load and save the current user's profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode values, and base styling.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceExport.ts: Generates monthly attendance CSV files and filenames based on students and roll call data.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceRepo.ts: Deprecated localStorage-based attendance getter and saver kept for legacy use.
frontend/src/lib/csv.ts: CSV utilities for escaping fields, converting rows to CSV, and triggering downloads.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Helpers for formatting dates, generating today's date, and producing Hindi day-of-week strings.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Utility wrappers for safely reading and writing JSON data in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/studentsRepo.ts: Deprecated localStorage-based student repository for retrieving, adding, and deleting students.
frontend/src/lib/summary.ts: Computes present, absent, and total counts from an attendance record.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines basic Student, AttendanceStatus, and AttendanceRecord types.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates student form fields and returns error messages for empty inputs.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Provides utilities to normalize phone numbers and build single or bulk WhatsApp message payloads, with legacy link helpers.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappTemplate.ts: Manages WhatsApp message templates with localStorage persistence and renders personalized or bulk attendance messages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app by setting up query client, identity provider, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Displays students for a selected class/date, manages attendance state, saves roll call, and triggers WhatsApp messages.
frontend/src/pages/ClassSelectionPage.ts: Allows the user to pick a class and section before proceeding to the student list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page providing a simple entry point to start the attendance workflow.
frontend/src/pages/StudentListPage.tsx: Shows class students with options to add, edit, delete, and send bulk WhatsApp messages, with authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays attendance summary and supports monthly attendance export with authentication validation.
React page for editing, saving, resetting, and previewing WhatsApp attendance message templates with placeholder insertion and live preview.
frontend/src/state/attendanceSession.tsx: Provides React context for storing selected class, section, and date, with helpers to update session state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash/query parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, issues, and pending requests for fixing class visibility and adding monthly attendance export.
